# Kamigotchi Progress Notes

## Account
- Label: main, Name: Kamitron, index: 3375
- Owner: 0xf130f9f4B905f48B207B7127A027270b25a0B18e
- Operator: 0x10C614Bd562f358FE104D101FBd7Ef81718B4D3A
- Registered on-chain, kamibots registered & enabled (operator key stored w/
  kamibots service, but NOT using bot strategies currently - manual control
  only).
- Gas: fine as of session 60 (checked ~06:40 UTC 2026-08-25, operator
  ~0.0045 ETH, owner ~0.0045 ETH, owner_mainnet ~0.0099 ETH). Bridge/fund
  if operator or owner dips under ~0.001.

## IMPORTANT: Quest index == MSQ number directly!
quest_index 9 = MSQ009, 10 = MSQ010, etc. STRICTLY LINEAR CHAIN, confirmed
many sessions: quest N+1 accept_quest REVERTS "reqs not met" until quest N
is COMPLETED (not just accepted).

## *** HARVEST_TIME quest objective mechanic (confirmed many sessions) ***
Quests 18/19/20 etc ("Harvest for >=720 min at node X") do NOT work by
wall-clock polling of quest_state. The HARVEST_TIME data counter is only
incremented by HarvestStopSystem ("Log harvest time"), NOT by
HarvestCollectSystem, and NOT continuously by block time. Collecting
(harvest_collect) claims bounty/XP/scavenge but does NOT log harvest time.
The logged amount is based on the harvest entity's TimeStart (persists
across collects/feeds, only reset by a fresh harvest_start).
PRACTICAL UPSHOT: start harvesting at target node, wait (real wall-clock)
at least the required duration, feed/collect freely as needed for kami
health/MUSU in the meantime (SAFE, doesn't reset progress), then call
harvest_stop on that kami. This logs the harvest time and should make the
quest immediately completable.
*** harvest_start ALSO shares the SAME per-kami cooldown as harvest_stop/
collect/feed (~60-190s, observed up to ~2min) - confirmed session 59: you
CANNOT immediately re-harvest a kami at a new node right after stopping
it elsewhere. Budget ~2min idle after every harvest_stop before the next
harvest_start on that same kami. Poll lens_kami's cooldownSec field and
retry once it hits 0 (it did work at exactly 0, not before).

## *** DANGER: HP CAN GET CRITICALLY LOW BETWEEN SESSIONS / EVEN MID-SESSION ***
Session 59 opened with kami 20699 at 2/110 HP (2%!) and 9787 at 13/90 HP
(14%!). Session 60 opened even WORSE: kami 20699 (the quest-20 harvester,
started ~01:05:30 UTC 2026-08-25 at 28/110 HP) was found at EXACTLY 0 HP
after only ~5.5h elapsed (hpRatePerHr showed 0.00, musu accrual rate
0.00 - looked dead-ish) but its on-chain `state` field STILL READ
"HARVESTING", not "DEAD" - the death transition is apparently LAZY and
only resolved on interaction (some kind of on-touch check), not applied
proactively by the indexer/lens. feed_kami on it SUCCEEDED (would have
reverted "kami dead" if truly dead) and restored it to 100/110 HP,
saving the run. LESSON: a kami reading hp.current=0 with rate 0.00 is
NOT necessarily unrecoverable - try feed_kami before assuming it's dead
and reaching for a revive item. But don't rely on this margin: hpRatePerHr
is noisy (-3.5 to -12.3/hr+ seen) and a single feed calculated to "last
12h" can run out in half that. LESSON: after ANY harvest_start intended
to run long (12h quest), feed with the BIGGEST food item available
(Spell Card = 100hp) immediately, and schedule a mid-point wake at
MOST 4-5h out (not 6+) to recheck HP, especially early in a fresh 12h
timer when starting HP was already low. ALWAYS lens_kami both active
harvesters at the START of every session before doing anything else,
and feed immediately regardless of what `state` claims if hp.current
looks low or zero - try feed_kami; only fall back to revive_kami if
feed_kami itself reverts.

## *** travel_to_room dry_run / use_items=False stamina reporting can be WRONG ***
Session 60: dry_run reported stamina_have=15 when lens_account (moments
earlier) read current stamina 100/100. Real execution with
use_items=False actually consumed real stamina from the TRUE current
value (100), executed 3 hops (15 stamina) then stopped early claiming
"insufficient stamina" even though 85 remained afterward (confirmed via
fresh lens_account read: 85/100). CONCLUSION: the tool's internal
stamina figure used for planning/gating can be stale/wrong; it does NOT
corrupt on-chain state (moves that DID execute are correct and final),
it just stops early / mis-plans. WORKAROUND: if a travel call stops
short claiming low stamina but you know (via fresh lens_account) you
have plenty, just call travel_to_room again with the same target - it
resumes from the actual current room and typically completes fine
(happened session 60: second call finished the remaining 8 hops
correctly). Don't burn a stamina-restore item reflexively when this
happens - check real stamina first.

## Session 60 actions (~06:40-06:42 UTC 2026-08-25) - SUMMARY
1. Opened session in room 37 (Hollow Path, from session 59's travel).
   Checked both harvesters immediately:
   - 9787 (node 29): 34/90 HP (38%), rate -6.54/hr - draining fast.
   - 20699 (node 37, quest-20 harvester): hp.current=0, hp.percent=0,
     rate 0.00, musu rate 0.00, but state STILL "HARVESTING" (see danger
     note above - lazy death resolution).
2. feed_kami(20699, Spell Card 11305) while already in room 37 ->
   SUCCEEDED (proving alive) -> 100/110 HP, rate back to -5.42/hr. Hit
   one transient "pool reached max tx capacity" on the first attempt,
   retried successfully.
3. Traveled room 37->29 to reach 9787 (11 hops total: 37-25-36-9-33-31-
   47-4-30-3-2-29, 55 stamina). First travel_to_room call
   (use_items=False) mis-reported low stamina and stopped after 3 hops
   at room 9; real stamina was fine (85/100 confirmed), second
   travel_to_room call to the same target completed the remaining 8
   hops with no issues.
4. feed_kami(9787, Spell Card 11305) -> 90/90 HP (100%), rate -3.66/hr.
5. harvest_collect([9787]) -> banked its ~517 accrued MUSU + scavenge
   points at node 29 without stopping the harvest (progress toward any
   future node-29 HARVEST_TIME quest, if any, is unaffected since
   collect doesn't log harvest time anyway per the mechanic above).
6. Account now in room 29, stamina ~45/100 (approx, spent on travel +
   some regen). Both kamis healthy and HARVESTING, no other actions
   taken - saving remaining stamina/time for the next wake.

## NEXT SESSION PLAN (~13:10-13:20 UTC 2026-08-25 wake):
1. lens_kami(20699) and lens_kami(9787) FIRST THING regardless of what
   `state` claims - feed proactively (Spell Card if available, else
   Resin/Ghost Gum) if HP looks low, even if it reads 0 (try feed
   first, it may still succeed per the danger note above).
2. Quest-20 timer (kami 20699 @ node 37) should be >=720min elapsed
   since ~01:05:30 UTC 2026-08-25 by ~13:05:30 UTC - i.e. READY. Travel
   to room 37 (from wherever the account ended up - check lens_account
   first, don't assume room 29), harvest_stop([20699]) to log the time,
   then quest_state(20) should show active_ready -> complete_quest(20).
3. After quest 20 completes: accept_quest(21) and onward - "Squaring
   the Circle" series (visit + scavenge specific rooms: Scrap Trees,
   Centipedes, Blooming Tree, Airplane Crash, Clearing, Labs Entrance
   again) - short, no 12h timers, likely completable in one sitting.
   Use get_expected_objective for each as accepted (don't re-dump the
   whole quest registry). Then 27 (Lost Skeleton scavenge -> KW Maps
   Data Chip), 28 (Scrap Confluence scavenge, data chip reader), 29
   (buy something in Marketplace room 66 - auction_buy item 10 or 11,
   or listing_buy). Then 30-36 Mina reagent questline (unlocks Caves at
   35). Then 37-46+ cave scavenging/crafting quests.
4. Decide what to do with kami 20699 after quest 20 completes (keep
   harvesting node 37, or reposition for quest 21+ objectives which
   may need different rooms/nodes) based on what get_expected_objective
   for quest 21 actually requires.

## Key learnings (carried over + new this session)
- HARVEST_TIME quest objectives only log progress on harvest_stop, not
  on harvest_collect or by wall-clock alone.
- harvest_start shares the SAME per-kami cooldown as harvest_stop/collect/
  feed (~60-190s, up to ~2min observed) - cannot immediately re-harvest a
  kami at a new node right after stopping it elsewhere. Poll
  lens_kami().cooldownSec and retry once it's exactly 0.
- Harvest entity has TimeStart (persists across collects, set at
  harvest_start) vs TimeLast (bounty math only) vs TimeReset (intensity
  reset, updated by feeding or harvest_start) - three DIFFERENT
  timestamps, don't confuse them.
- Feeding a kami resets its "Intensity" stat (bounty ramp-up), NOT the
  harvest's TimeStart - always safe for HARVEST_TIME quest progress.
- quest_state(N) is the cheapest way to check completed/active_blocked/
  active_ready (free, no gas). For HARVEST_TIME quests, don't bother
  polling until AFTER harvest_stop past the required duration.
- feed_kami / harvest_collect / harvest_stop all require the ACCOUNT be
  in the SAME ROOM as the kami's node ("kami too far" otherwise) - even
  though the kami itself is pinned to the node's room while harvesting.
- scavenge_claim_and_reveal does NOT require room co-location.
- Gas is very cheap on Yominet - a whole session of ~15-25 transactions
  costs a small fraction of a cent in ETH. Not a concern for a long
  time.
- Room graph (confirmed segments): 26 <-> 31 <-> 47 <-> 4 <-> 30 <-> 3 <->
  2 <-> 29. Room 12 <-> 34 <-> 4. Path 12->6: 12-34-4-47-31-5-32-6 (7
  hops). Path 6->29: 6-32-5-31-47-4-30-3-2-29 (9 hops, 45 stamina).
  Path 6->37 (Hollow Path): 6-32-5-31-33-9-36-25-37 (8 hops, 40 stamina).
  Path 37->29: 37-25-36-9-33-31-47-4-30-3-2-29 (11 hops, 55 stamina).
- Node index == room index always (confirmed repeatedly).
- RESTING heals at +19.2 HP/hr. Kamis follow the account/operator while
  RESTING (not tied to a room); once HARVESTING they stay pinned to
  their node's room until stopped, independent of account movement.
- HP drain rate while harvesting is NOT strictly constant per kami -
  observed anywhere from -3.5/hr to -12.3/hr, seemingly noisy/dependent
  on HP% but not purely deterministic - don't assume a fixed rate for
  time-to-death math, recheck via lens_kami before deciding whether a
  feed is urgent, and err on the side of a BIG feed (Spell Card,
  75-100hp) before any long unattended period, or a mid-point check-in
  at MOST 4-5h out, not 6+.
- A kami reading hp.current=0 may STILL be alive on-chain (state field
  lazily stuck at "HARVESTING") - feed_kami can succeed and save it.
  Try feeding before assuming DEAD/reaching for revive_kami.
- travel_to_room's internal stamina accounting (dry_run and the
  use_items=False gating) can read STALE/wrong values vs. real
  on-chain stamina - if it stops early citing insufficient stamina,
  double check with a fresh lens_account before spending a stamina
  item; often just re-calling travel_to_room to the same target
  resumes and completes fine on the real (higher) stamina balance.
- Scavenge droptables (2^weight/sum probability, NOT linear):
  Node 29 (Misty Forest Path, Insect): Wooden Stick 40%, Stone 40%,
  Resin 20%.
  Node 30 (Scrapyard Entrance, Scrap): Stone 72.7%, Scrap Metal 18.2%,
  Cheeseburger 9.1%.
  Node 6 (Labs Entrance, Eerie): Stone 100% (single-item table).
  Node 37 (Hollow Path, Normal): Wooden Stick 80%, Pine Cone 20%.
  tier_cost 200 at node 37 (vs 100 at nodes 29/6).
  Node 12 (Scrap Confluence) droptable not yet checked.
- Scavenge points only increment on harvest_collect/harvest_stop (the
  accrued musu amount at that moment is added 1:1 to points). Points do
  NOT reset after a claim - claimable_tiers = floor(points/tier_cost),
  remainder = points % tier_cost, keeps accumulating.
- KamiSwap take_trade takes the WHOLE order, no partial fill - not
  economical for small quantity needs. Keep farming naturally via
  scavenge.
- Mina (merchant 1, room 13) sells various food/stamina items, GDA
  pricing (rises per unit bought, decays over 86400s w/ 0.5 factor).
- Full quest registry text (indices 1-46) dumped in earlier sessions
  (lens_quests) - don't re-fetch every session, it's huge. Use
  get_expected_objective(N) for single-quest lookups instead.
- 1 move = 5 stamina always. Stamina regen ~1/min (100 cap).
- travel_to_room's use_items default(true) can waste stamina items even
  when current stamina covers the path - pass use_items=False to avoid.
  BUT see the stale-stamina-reporting note above; it may stop early
  incorrectly, just retry.
- travel_to_room (and harvest_start/other txs) can hit transient RPC
  errors ("pool reached max tx capacity") - just retry the same call,
  travel resumes from wherever the account actually stopped (completed
  hops are final, nothing lost); other txs just need a plain retry.
- lens_room / lens_node with_vitals on crowded rooms (e.g. 12, 37) can
  return a MASSIVE dump (>90-180KB, gets truncated in responses) -
  avoid re-fetching unless necessary; if scanning for quest 6
  liquidation targets, treat it as an expensive, low-yield check, not a
  routine one.
- Node 37 (Hollow Path) has 100+ ACTIVE harvests from a single other
  account "dias" (index 3112) - checked once for quest 6 opportunism,
  none eligible (all well above liquidation HP threshold). Could recheck
  occasionally but it's expensive in tokens; low priority.

## Kamis (as of session 60, ~06:42 UTC 2026-08-25)
- Kami 9787 (level 1, 90 HP max): HARVESTING at node 29 (Misty Forest
  Path, Insect). HP 90/90 (100%) after this session's Spell Card feed +
  harvest_collect. hpRatePerHr ~-3.66/hr (safe ~24h).
- Kami 20699 (level 1, 110 HP max): HARVESTING at node 37 (Hollow Path)
  since ~01:05:30 UTC 2026-08-25 (quest 20 timer start - target
  ~13:05:30 UTC). HP 100/110 (91%) after this session's Spell Card feed
  (was found at HP 0 - see danger note above). hpRatePerHr ~-5.42/hr
  (safe ~18h). DO NOT harvest_stop before ~13:05-13:10 UTC 2026-08-25.
- Both kamis level 1 still - never leveled up. Not prioritized (XP
  banked from harvesting is going somewhere - check lens_kami xp field

## Inventory snapshot (session 60, ~06:42 UTC, AFTER feeds this session -
## used 2 Spell Cards (11305), leaving 3-2=1... wait see below):
- MUSU: 6371+ (517 from 9787 collect this session, not yet re-verified
  fresh balance)
- Wooden Stick: 3, Stone: 53, Scrap Metal: 4
- Red Ribbon Gummy (revive, item 11001): 1
- Maple-Flavor Ghost Gum (25hp food, item 11301): 7
- "Paeon's Field of Flowers" Spell Card (100hp food, item 11305): 1

- Resin (35hp food, item 11311): 3
- "Neith's River of Life Spell Card" (+80 stamina, item 21204): 1
  (NOT used this session - travel completed on stamina alone after
  retry, see stamina note above)
- Note: "Melkarth's Heroic Awakening" Spell Card mentioned as a quest 20
  reward in session 59 notes - not yet confirmed received/checked,
  re-verify inventory next session for any new items.

## Quests completed: 1-19.
## Quest in progress: 20 (Harvesting Data III - 12h continuous harvest at
  Hollow Path/node 37, kami 20699). Started ~01:05:30 UTC 2026-08-25.
  Target ready time ~13:05-13:10 UTC 2026-08-25. Feed checked/topped up

## Key learnings (carried over + new this session)
- HARVEST_TIME quest objectives only log progress on harvest_stop, not
  on harvest_collect or by wall-clock alone.
- harvest_start shares the SAME per-kami cooldown as harvest_stop/collect/
  feed (~60-190s, up to ~2min observed) - cannot immediately re-harvest a
  kami at a new node right after stopping it elsewhere. Poll
  lens_kami().cooldownSec and retry once it's exactly 0.
- Harvest entity has TimeStart (persists across collects, set at
  harvest_start) vs TimeLast (bounty math only) vs TimeReset (intensity
  reset, updated by feeding or harvest_start) - three DIFFERENT
  timestamps, don't confuse them.
- Feeding a kami resets its "Intensity" stat (bounty ramp-up), NOT the
  harvest's TimeStart - always safe for HARVEST_TIME quest progress.
- quest_state(N) is the cheapest way to check completed/active_blocked/
  active_ready (free, no gas). For HARVEST_TIME quests, don't bother
  polling until AFTER harvest_stop past the required duration.
- feed_kami / harvest_collect / harvest_stop all require the ACCOUNT be
  in the SAME ROOM as the kami's node ("kami too far" otherwise) - even
  though the kami itself is pinned to the node's room while harvesting.
- scavenge_claim_and_reveal does NOT require room co-location.
- Gas is very cheap on Yominet - a whole session of ~15-25 transactions
  costs a small fraction of a cent in ETH. Not a concern for a long
  time.
- Room graph (confirmed segments): 26 <-> 31 <-> 47 <-> 4 <-> 30 <-> 3 <->
  2 <-> 29. Room 12 <-> 34 <-> 4. Path 12->6: 12-34-4-47-31-5-32-6 (7
  hops). Path 6->29: 6-32-5-31-47-4-30-3-2-29 (9 hops, 45 stamina).
  Path 6->37 (Hollow Path): 6-32-5-31-33-9-36-25-37 (8 hops, 40 stamina).
  Path 37->29: 37-25-36-9-33-31-47-4-30-3-2-29 (11 hops, 55 stamina).
- Node index == room index always (confirmed repeatedly).
- RESTING heals at +19.2 HP/hr. Kamis follow the account/operator while
  RESTING (not tied to a room); once HARVESTING they stay pinned to
  their node's room until stopped, independent of account movement.
- HP drain rate while harvesting is NOT strictly constant per kami -
  observed anywhere from -3.5/hr to -12.3/hr, seemingly noisy/dependent
  on HP% but not purely deterministic - don't assume a fixed rate for
  time-to-death math, recheck via lens_kami before deciding whether a
  feed is urgent, and err on the side of a BIG feed (Spell Card,
  75-100hp) before any long unattended period, or a mid-point check-in
  at MOST 4-5h out, not 6+.
- A kami reading hp.current=0 may STILL be alive on-chain (state field
  lazily stuck at "HARVESTING") - feed_kami can succeed and save it.
  Try feeding before assuming DEAD/reaching for revive_kami.
- travel_to_room's internal stamina accounting (dry_run and the
  use_items=False gating) can read STALE/wrong values vs. real
  on-chain stamina - if it stops early citing insufficient stamina,
  double check with a fresh lens_account before spending a stamina
  item; often just re-calling travel_to_room to the same target
  resumes and completes fine on the real (higher) stamina balance.
- Scavenge droptables (2^weight/sum probability, NOT linear):
  Node 29 (Misty Forest Path, Insect): Wooden Stick 40%, Stone 40%,
  Resin 20%.
  Node 30 (Scrapyard Entrance, Scrap): Stone 72.7%, Scrap Metal 18.2%,
  Cheeseburger 9.1%.
  Node 6 (Labs Entrance, Eerie): Stone 100% (single-item table).
  Node 37 (Hollow Path, Normal): Wooden Stick 80%, Pine Cone 20%.
  tier_cost 200 at node 37 (vs 100 at nodes 29/6).
  Node 12 (Scrap Confluence) droptable not yet checked.
- Scavenge points only increment on harvest_collect/harvest_stop (the
  accrued musu amount at that moment is added 1:1 to points). Points do
  NOT reset after a claim - claimable_tiers = floor(points/tier_cost),
  remainder = points % tier_cost, keeps accumulating.
- KamiSwap take_trade takes the WHOLE order, no partial fill - not
  economical for small quantity needs. Keep farming naturally via
  scavenge.
- Mina (merchant 1, room 13) sells various food/stamina items, GDA
  pricing (rises per unit bought, decays over 86400s w/ 0.5 factor).
- Full quest registry text (indices 1-46) dumped in earlier sessions
  (lens_quests) - don't re-fetch every session, it's huge. Use
  get_expected_objective(N) for single-quest lookups instead.
- 1 move = 5 stamina always. Stamina regen ~1/min (100 cap).
- travel_to_room's use_items default(true) can waste stamina items even
  when current stamina covers the path - pass use_items=False to avoid.
  BUT see the stale-stamina-reporting note above; it may stop early
  incorrectly, just retry.
- travel_to_room (and harvest_start/other txs) can hit transient RPC
  errors ("pool reached max tx capacity") - just retry the same call,
  travel resumes from wherever the account actually stopped (completed
  hops are final, nothing lost); other txs just need a plain retry.
- lens_room / lens_node with_vitals on crowded rooms (e.g. 12, 37) can
  return a MASSIVE dump (>90-180KB, gets truncated in responses) -
  avoid re-fetching unless necessary; if scanning for quest 6
  liquidation targets, treat it as an expensive, low-yield check, not a
  routine one.
- Node 37 (Hollow Path) has 100+ ACTIVE harvests from a single other
  account "dias" (index 3112) - checked once for quest 6 opportunism,

> Source: `packages/contracts/src/libraries/LibHarvest.sol` (L1–439),

> `packages/contracts/src/systems/HarvestLiquidateSystem.sol`,
> `packages/contracts/src/libraries/LibKill.sol`,
> `packages/contracts/src/libraries/LibTax.sol`,
> `packages/contracts/src/libraries/utils/LibAffinity.sol`,
> `packages/contracts/deployment/world/state/configs/configs.ts` (L127–137)

## Overview

Harvesting is the primary resource-generation loop in Kamigotchi. A Kami is
assigned to a **node** (a resource spot within a room) and passively generates
**Musu** (the base resource) over time. Harvesting drains HP via **strain**,
and other players can **liquidate** (PvP raid) active harvests.

Strictly, the harvest pays out the node's configured yield item
(`LibNode.getItem`, applied in `LibHarvest.claim` — `LibHarvest.sol:97–99`),
set per node via the `YieldIndex` column in deployment data: 53 nodes yield
Musu (item 1) and 11 yield item 2 — see `catalogs/rooms/nodes.csv`.

## Harvest Lifecycle

```
START → [accruing bounty, taking strain] → COLLECT (partial) or STOP (full)
                                         ↘ LIQUIDATE (PvP death)
```

### Start (`HarvestStartSystem`)

**Inputs**: `kamiID`, `nodeIndex`, `taxerID`, `taxAmt`

**Prerequisites**:
1. Kami is owned by caller's account
2. Kami state is `RESTING`
3. Kami is not on cooldown
4. Kami is healthy (HP > 0)
5. Account and node are in the same room
6. Node-specific requirements are met (e.g., level, items)

**Process**:
1. Sync Kami health (pre-bonus)
2. Assign node bonuses to the Kami
3. Sync again (apply bonuses)
4. Create or reuse harvest entity, link to node
5. Set up tax (if `taxAmt > 0`, the `taxerID` receives `taxAmt` **basis
   points** of output, capped at 2000 bp = 20% — see [Tax System](#tax-system))
6. Set Kami state → `HARVESTING`
7. Start cooldown (consumes `UPON_COOLDOWN_SET` bonuses, e.g. Energy Drink)

> Source: `HarvestStartSystem.sol:24–57`

### Collect (`HarvestCollectSystem`)

Withdraws accrued bounty **without stopping** the harvest.

**Prerequisites**: ownership, state `HARVESTING`, cooldown clear, healthy, same room

**Process**:
1. Sync Kami health
2. Claim accrued balance (split by tax)
3. Transfer items to account (and tax recipients)
4. Grant **XP equal to the post-tax output** to the Kami
5. Add the post-tax output to the account's scavenge bar for the node — no
   droptable roll here (see `mechanics/world/scavenging.md`)
6. Reset cooldown (consumes `UPON_COOLDOWN_SET` bonuses, e.g. Energy Drink)
7. Reset harvest-action bonuses

> Source: `HarvestCollectSystem.sol:84–113`

### Stop (`HarvestStopSystem`)

Collects all accrued bounty **and ends** the harvest.

**Prerequisites**: same as Collect

**Process**:
1. Sync Kami health
2. Claim full accrued balance (split by tax)
3. Stop harvest (set `INACTIVE`, zero balance)
4. Set Kami state → `RESTING`
5. Grant XP equal to the post-tax output
6. Add the post-tax output to the account's scavenge bar for the node (no
   droptable roll here)
7. Reset all harvest-stop bonuses
8. Reset cooldown (consumes `UPON_COOLDOWN_SET` bonuses, e.g. Energy Drink)
9. Log harvest time

> Source: `HarvestStopSystem.sol:88–124`

### Liquidate (`HarvestLiquidateSystem`)

## Harvest Entity Shape

Each harvest is an ECS entity with:

| Component | Value |
|---|---|
| `EntityType` | `"HARVEST"` |
| `IdHolder` | Kami entity ID |
| `IdSource` | Node entity ID |
| `State` | `"ACTIVE"` or `"INACTIVE"` |
| `TimeStart` | Timestamp when harvest started |
| `TimeLast` | Timestamp of last sync |
| `TimeReset` | Timestamp of last intensity reset |
| `Value` | Accrued but unclaimed bounty |

Entity ID: `keccak256("harvest", kamiID)` — one harvest per Kami.
